data: Amazon Leo broadband — 3,236 sats planned, commercial beta 2026

Amazon Leo commercial constellation (rebranded from Project Kuiper in November 2025). First prototype launch October 2023; first 27 production satellites April 2025. Ramp-phase deployment continuing 2025-2026. FCC license requires 50% deployment by July 2026, 100% by 2029; extension request pending as of July 2026.
Amazon LEO broadband — 3,236 sats planned, commercial beta 2026

Amazon's answer to Starlink — 3,236 satellites at 590-630 km in 98 orbital planes. First prototype launch in October 2023 (KuiperSat-1 and -2 test launch); first 27 production satellites launched April 2025 atop Atlas V. As of mid-2026, ~230+ production satellites are operational. FCC license requires 50% deployment (1,618 sats) by July 2026 and 100% by July 2029; Amazon has requested a two-year extension due to the current shortfall. The constellation is expected to roughly double the LEO active-satellite population if fully deployed.
